**AGREE**  
- Management says AI services are “growing at double‑digit Q‑on‑Q” and that AI now accounts for “8.2 % of overall revenue in Q1” (July 2026 call). The quarterly sales numbers show a steady rise from ₹40,925 cr (Mar 2025) to ₹48,211 cr (Jun 2026), a 2.4 % YoY increase in Q1, consistent with modest but positive growth.  
- The company highlighted a “large‑deal pipeline” of $3.6 bn in Q1 and $14.9 bn for the full FY 2026, while operating margin guidance remains at 20‑22 %. The reported operating profit margin (OPM) stayed at 24 % in most quarters and only slipped to 23 % in Dec 2025, supporting the claim that margins are holding up despite macro‑uncertainty.  

**DIVERGE**  
- Management lowered FY 2027 revenue growth guidance to 1.5‑3 % (July 2026) and later to 1.5‑3.5 % (April 2026), citing “macro environment” and a “one‑time revenue impact.” Yet the annual sales have risen from ₹162,990 cr (Mar 2025) to ₹178,650 cr (Mar 2026), a 9.6 % increase, and the FY 2026 growth rate was 3.1 % YoY in constant currency – higher than the lower end of the new guidance, suggesting the outlook may be more pessimistic than the recent performance warrants.  
- The CFO noted that “lower third‑party‑related revenue” (‑1 %) and “lower on‑site mix” (‑70 bps) trimmed FY 2026 growth to 3.1 %. However, net profit actually rose from ₹26,750 cr (Mar 2025) to ₹29,474 cr (Mar 2026), a 10 % jump, indicating profitability is improving faster than the revenue‑growth narrative suggests.
